comments.body: Does compiling the code again result in the same crash? If so, is it feasible for you to provide the code you compiled that caused this crash?
Sorry, unfortunately I cannot share the code(Company policy). After upgrading Rust to `1.93.1`, this issue is happening more frequently.

> this issue is happening more frequently

Does this mean that compiling your code sometimes crashes the compiler, but compiling that same code sometimes works fine?

Is the backtrace different brtween different invocations? This has all the behavior of defective hardware (which happens from time to time and rustc is especially fragile in the face of bad hardware). Can you run memtest86 to test your RAM, and what's your CPU?
Does this occur on your coworker's computers, or only on your computer?

> memtest86+

right now I don't have USB flash drive to run memtest86+ tool

Given that it only happens on your computer and is spurious and the backtrace looks pretty odd I'm pretty sure that this is indeed a hardware issue. We get these reports from time to time, rustc is particularly fragile on broken hardware. It's entirely plausible that the rest of your system appears to work just fine.

It's likely bad RAM, but that's not the only possibility. Either way, I'm going to close this issue since it's almost certainly not a bug in Rust.
Bad SSDs/HDDs can fail/corrupt writes also, and the compiler does a lot of disk writing and reading.
